description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'HomeActivity' that serves as the main navigation shell for the app, including a Scaffold with AppBar, Drawer, and body content switching between various fragments based on user interaction.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages the main navigation and drawer for the app.

classes.name: _HomeActivityState
classes.description: State class for HomeActivity, managing selected drawer item, app bar title, and body content.

classes.name: _DrawerItem
classes.description: Model class representing an item in the navigation drawer with icon and label.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for HomeActivity.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes display name and email from widget properties or preferences.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Scaffold with AppBar, Drawer, and body based on current state.

methods.name: _buildDrawer
methods.description: Constructs the navigation drawer with header and menu items.

methods.name: _buildBody
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment widget based on selected drawer index.

methods.name: _onDrawerItemTapped
methods.description: Updates selected index and title, then closes the drawer.
